grounding.note: The `dump` branch returns dump.main(rest), a direct invocation of C31's module entry.
The `balance` branch returns balance.main(rest) — a direct call into C13's balance.py.
The `lint-fragment` branch returns lint_fragment.main(rest), C7's entry function.
anchor_index walks the typed ProjectModel's fields (components, deps, entities, edges, flows) that model.py defines — a genuine read of C3's data model.
`loc = parse_anchor(raw)` invokes anchors.parse_anchor, imported at impact_lib.py:25.
load_extents reads the `symbols.extents` table out of the pre-index document C9 produces (the file itself is opened by the server and handed in as a dict).
The whole-map dump is written through model.to_canonical_json(m); load_model at dump.py:153 is a second call into C3.
loadImpact fetches API_BASE + 'impact?…' from the local map server — a real request to C24's route.

The impact summary assigns panel.innerHTML directly, taking over the info pane's element rather than calling C37 — 'writes' is the honest verb.
`if (cvPath) loadCode(cvPath, cvLine)` invokes the code viewer's loader defined at viewer.js:5783; syncTreeDiff() on 6865 is a second C38 call.
build_profile passes map text through coyodex.model.load_model before profiling.

The stored anchor (profile.py:129) actually calls validate_model.validate_model, the orchestrator at validate_model.py:2296 which the map assigns to C15 — but profile.py:154/155/159 do call C10-region helpers (external_entry_points at validate_model.py:472) directly, so the edge survives with a corrected anchor.
`findings = audit_model.audit_model(m)` — a direct call into C12, plus l2_worklist_model at 135.

`expected_components(root)` is preindex_lib's granularity expectation, imported at profile.py:30.
`balance_lib.fanout_summary(m)` invokes C13's balance_lib directly.
write_run renders the archived md view with views.model_to_markdown (views.py:236, C20's own source line).
archive_view_bundle calls gen_viewer.build_view_bundle, defined at gen_viewer.py:2766 — C22's source line.
run_eval calls compare(), defined at compare.py:227 (C46's source line); build_judge_report at run.py:63 is a second C46 call.

The same statement wraps load_model(map_text) — coyodex.model, imported at judge.py:33.
`anchor_drift(item.anchor, evidence, DRIFT_TOLERANCE)` calls coyodex.anchors.anchor_drift (anchors.py:135), not the same-named C8 module.
The manifest ends by sending the agent to COYODEX_HOME/method/dispatch.md, a C1 file — a real dispatch, so 'routes-to' fits.
The manifest points every tool run at the clone's `.venv/bin/coyodex` command; it is a doc reference, not an invocation, which is why 'uses' rather than 'calls' is honest.
The `reconcile` branch returns reconcile_build.main(rest); the anchor-drift and fix branches (111, 114) route into C8's other modules.
build_file_tree calls preindex_lib.iter_source_files, lazily imported one line earlier.
The module-load `await fetch(API_BASE + 'view')` really requests the server's view route; the line is boot code far above C23's source line, but the map itself declares it C23's entry point.

The stored anchor (2266, nodeDesc) sits in C37's own selection machinery — a self-edge — but render() at 4537 does call selectNode/showNodeDetailSynced at 4611 and 4960, so the edge holds from C23's code; the verb is really 'calls', not 'routes-to'.
The delegated .srclink handler calls openInCodeViewer (defined at 5852, C38), but it is bound to BOTH the diagram and the info pane (line 148), so the same line equally supports a C37→C38 edge.
project_view calls views.model_to_graph (views.py:676) on the loaded map.

project_tree calls filetree.build_tree (filetree.py:186, C25's source line) with node_path_index/resolved_path_index.
build_view_bundle calls gen_context_mermaid, defined at gen_viewer.py:1325 — exactly C26's source line.
The bundle's mermaidDomain field calls gen_domain_mermaid, defined at gen_viewer.py:455 — C27's source line.
mermaidDeployment calls gen_deployment_mermaid, defined at gen_viewer.py:1943 — C28's source line.
flowsMm calls flow_mermaids (gen_viewer.py:2594), inside C29's 2392+ region.
